resources.string: Turn your phone into a three-button Bluetooth remote for your computer
Complete the three steps below to control video over other apps.
The floating controls can now send Space and the Left and Right Arrow keys.
Continue with the current step below. PauseSender keeps the settings you have completed.
Check the permissions and Bluetooth status, then try again.
Allow the nearby devices permission first
Allow nearby devices access and turn on Bluetooth. PauseSender does not need location or accessibility permissions.
After connecting your computer, show a draggable control bar to pause, skip forward, or go back.
On your computer, open Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth. Select this phone and confirm the pairing code on both devices. The computer should recognize it as a keyboard.
